primarySources.title: AcceptEx
primarySources.notes: receiveLength=0 returns after connection without waiting for data; obtain extension through WSAIoctl; update accept context before getsockopt

primarySources.title: getsockopt
primarySources.notes: SO_CONNECT_TIME returns connected seconds; no documented rounding or error bound for reconstructing an exact TCP establishment timestamp

primarySources.title: SOL_SOCKET options
primarySources.notes: SO_CONNECT_TIME and SO_UPDATE_ACCEPT_CONTEXT scope; options do not claim exact aggregate kernel memory bounds

primarySources.title: CancelIoEx
primarySources.notes: requesting cancellation is not completion; keep OVERLAPPED live until actual completion

primarySources.title: closesocket
primarySources.notes: close initiates cancellation and does not itself prove all asynchronous operations completed

primarySources.title: GetQueuedCompletionStatus
primarySources.notes: nonnull OVERLAPPED distinguishes dequeued failed operation from no-packet timeout; low-power waiting differs Win7 versus Win8+

primarySources.title: listen
primarySources.notes: provider pending queue and backlog are transport-managed; requested backlog is not an application memory hard bound

primarySources.title: AcceptSecurityContext (Schannel)
primarySources.notes: same context cannot be used concurrently; partial contexts require DeleteSecurityContext; API provides no timeout parameter or documented arbitrary cancel guarantee

import sys, runpy, json, hashlib, uuid
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
helpers=runpy.run_path('scripts/windows-probe.py')
Remote, ps=helpers['Remote'], helpers['ps_literal']
r=Remote('elior@192.168.10.212',Path('/config/.local/share/future-classroom-test-access/win11-192.168.10.212'))
records=[json.loads(line) for line in Path('/tmp/fc-round13-tcp-tests.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
paths=[Path(x['executable']) for x in records if x.get('reason')=='compiler-artifact' and x.get('profile',{}).get('test') and x.get('executable')]
assert len(paths)==1,paths
exe=paths[0]
token='FutureClassroom-TcpFrontdoor-Round13-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
directory=r.powershell("$p=Join-Path $env:TEMP "+ps(token)+";New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $p|Out-Null;Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $p '.future-classroom-probe-root') -Value "+ps(token)+";$p")
report={'scope':'Win11 x86 GNU test executable; own loopback-only plaintext finite admission candidate, not TLS server', 'executable':str(exe),'exeSha256':hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'directory':directory,'testArguments':['tcp_frontdoor','--nocapture','--test-threads=1']}
try:
    report['platform']=json.loads(r.powershell('$os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem;@{caption=$os.Caption;version=$os.Version;build=$os.BuildNumber;architecture=$os.OSArchitecture}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress'))
    r.upload(exe,directory)
    script="$exe=Join-Path "+ps(directory)+" "+ps(exe.name)+";$ErrorActionPreference='Continue';$output=@(& $exe tcp_frontdoor --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1|ForEach-Object{\"$_\"});$code=$LASTEXITCODE;$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';@{exitCode=$code;output=$output;exeSha256=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $exe).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
    report['commandPowerShell']=script
    report['native']=json.loads(r.powershell(script,timeout=60))
finally:
    script="$root="+ps(directory)+";$ours=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process|Where-Object{$_.ExecutablePath -and $_.ExecutablePath.StartsWith($root+'\\',[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)});foreach($p in $ours){Stop-Process -Id $p.ProcessId -Force};if(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root '.future-classroom-probe-root')){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -Force};@{rootExists=(Test-Path -LiteralPath $root);ownProcessCount=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process|Where-Object{$_.ExecutablePath -and $_.ExecutablePath.StartsWith($root+'\\',[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)}).Count;sshd=(Get-Service sshd).Status.ToString();scheduledTasksCreated=0;systemSettingsChanged=0}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
    report['cleanup']=json.loads(r.powershell(script))
    Path('/tmp/fc-round13-tcp-native.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))
assert report['native']['exitCode']==0
assert report['native']['exeSha256']==report['exeSha256']
assert any('TCP_FRONTDOOR_CANDIDATE_PASS' in x for x in report['native']['output'])
assert not report['cleanup']['rootExists'] and report['cleanup']['ownProcessCount']==0
